name: Assign as $STATIC_MODIFIER_NAME_despot_modifier$
description:
Assign a [character|e] in the position of $STATIC_MODIFIER_NAME_despot_modifier$, with the following effects:
[ShowModifierEffect('despot_modifier')]

name: Compose Stratēgikòn
description: Our [ruler|e] will concentrate personal military expertise on a topic of war of choice. Such knowledge will surely help promote our prowess and exalt our famed martial capabilities.

name: Abdicate
description: The [character|e] will abdicate the throne.

name: Marry Aclla
description:
The [character|E] will be married off to the local governor of a target [province|E]. This will have the following effect on the province:
[ShowModifierEffect('aclla_distributed')]

name: Adapt to Local Culture
description: The [character|e] will adapt the [primary_culture|e] of the [country|e].

name: Appoint as Heir
description: The [character|e] will be chosen to be the appointed heir of the nation.

name: Assign as Dragoman
description:
Assign a [character|e] in the position of Dragoman, strengthening their culture's [cultural_influence|e] and [cultural_tradition|e], as well giving us the following effects:
[ShowModifierEffect('head_of_the_cabinet_modifier')]

name: Grant Governorship
description: Grant [area|e] to a [character|e] to govern in our stead.

name: Assume Fort Command
description: The [character|e] will assume control over the defenses of the target area and will be incapable of leading [armies|e] and [navies|e] and working in the [cabinet|e] for #Y 10#! years.

name: Banish
description: The [character|e] will be banished from the [country|e].

name: Choose Theologian Debater
description: The [character|e] will represent the [country|e] in the religious debate and influence its religious fate.

name: Commission Art
description: The [character|e] will create a [work_of_art|e].

name: Castrate
description: Order the castration of a [character|e] at our court. This punishment marks the target permanently and removes their ability to sire children.

name: Blind
description: Order the blinding of a [character|e] at our court. This ancient punishment renders the target unable to lead armies and diminishes their political standing.

name: Dismiss Artist
description: Remove this [artist|e] from our court. Word will spread that we are a difficult patron.

name: Dismiss Prince
description: The [character|e] will be dismissed as [ruler|e] of the [country|e].

name: Ennoble
description: The [character|e] and any descendants will be granted an aristocratic title.

name: Execute
description: The [character|e] will be executed.

name: Favor Heir
description: The [character|e] will be favored to be our new successor.

name: Grant Cabinet Right
description: The [character|e] gains the right to serve their ruler in the [cabinet|e].

name: Take the Throne
description: The [character|e] will become the new [ruler|e] of the [country|e].

name: Marry a Lowborn
description: The [character|e] will marry a [lowborn|e].

name: Marry a Noble
description: The [character|e] will marry a local noble.

name: Move Child to Our Court
description: The [character|e] will move to our [country|e].

name: Join Foreign Order of Chivalry
description: The [character|e] will join an #Y Order of Chivalry#! of a target country. The bonuses gained depend on the Order itself.

name: Invite to Order of Chivalry
description: The [character|e] will be invited to our #Y Order of Chivalry#!.

name: Reassign Cleric
description: The [character|e] will leave our [country|e] and take up an assignment in another one. The character's [total_ability|e] will affect the cost and the [mil|e] will affect how much [spy_network|e] we gain in the new country.

name: Pardon
description: The [character|e] gets pardoned.

name: Prefection
description: The [character|e] $prefection_common_desc$

name: Promote to Head of the Cabinet
description: The [character|e] will become [head_of_the_cabinet|e] until death or removal from the [cabinet|e].

name: Resign as Grandmaster
description: The [character|e] will resign as [ruler|e] of the [country|e].

name: Commit Seppuku
description: The [character|e] will commit Seppuku.

name: Take the Vows
description: The [character|e] will be forced to join a religious order.

name: Arrange Marriage
description: The [character|e] will marry someone important from our own tribe.
